summaryPt: Transforma a base da luva em Fists of Stone e melhora os mods explícitos dela; ignora requisito de atributo de luva. Com Lochtonial Caress, dá chance de cargas pros aliados (clones).
statsEn: Gloves you equip have their Base Type transformed to Fists of Stone while equipped, and
their Explicit Modifiers are transformed into more powerful related Modifiers
Ignore Attribute Requirements to equip Gloves
